items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a guy playing bass with me then that took Crosby's place... after he'd been with me for three years... he went with guess who? Erroll Garner, who didn't need it.

ctx.x: He didn't like it, and it began to be the rage around Chicago, and I -- I tried a little of the Strand where I was playing with my group, that at this Grand Ballroom (Unaudible), and it worked out real good. We -- I had a little keyboard, you know, made, not quite as big as the piano and I pressed these -- you know the story -- and that little we had too bar that would go behind the piano keyboard (Unaudible), but -- and I had a guy playing bass with me then that took Crosby's place, that was a legend.
